column2: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 1). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.
The next melee attack against the caster will cause 12 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 57 for 2 min.
The next melee attack on the caster will cause 40 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 155 for 2 min.

The one spellbook tab we were missing. Read from a clip of Esfand's stream a reader sent in (clipped by Zevzve): Bloodrage, Shield Wall, Taunt, Sunder Armor and the rest. Overpower corrected to rank 2 while we were in there.

The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.

The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

The second VOD sweep found one tooltip we had estimated: Improved Holy Strike 2/2 reduces the Holy Strike cooldown by 2 sec, read straight off Xaryu's day-2 stream. Reverence 3/3 and Voice of Truth on the same frame matched what the site already said. Everything else the sweep flagged turned out to be the reader misreading footage, not the site.

The spellbook was the last part of the site still read off BlizzCon demo footage, and those characters stopped at level 38. Now it comes from the beta's own files: every trainer spell to level 60, every rank, the level you learn it at, and what changed from Classic. Untick Show all ranks to see only the top rank, like the box in the game's book.

How it is checked. Every spell, rank and level comes straight from the game's own files. To test the files I read a real trainer in the beta. u/paraizord pointed out that a city trainer lists everything to 60, even for a level 1, so one visit shows a whole class. The Stormwind mage trainer sells 158 spells. The files had 157 of them, every level right, and the one they lacked is in the book now. The visit also showed which ranks the trainer doesn't sell, like Fireball rank 12 and the portals, and those say so in their tooltip. All the other classes get double verified the same way this weekend, and each book shows how far along that is.
The tank seal. Every hit adds Holy damage, and with a shield up you get an absorb worth half of it. Rank 4 by level 38.
The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.
The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.
The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 total nearby enemies will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.
The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 20 yards by 115. Lasts 3 min.
The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.
The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 114. Lasts 1 min.
The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 50 to 62. Lasts 1 min.

Web on Discord noticed the spellbook said Instant while the Enhancement tree still had two points to put into Improved Ghost Wolf. The Instant came from Guzu's Shaman, which had that talent at 2/2. It cuts 1 sec per rank, so the untalented spell is a 2 sec cast, down from 3 in Classic, and the book now says so. No untalented Shaman has hovered it on footage yet, so the note on the tooltip says where the number comes from.
